words.sentence: It took me a few months to adapt to life in a new city.
words.sentence_zh: 我花了几个月才适应新城市的生活。
words.roots: ad-（向）+ apt（适合）→ 使适合 → 适应；改编
words.hook: adapter 转接头：让插头「适合」插座

words.sentence: You can adjust the height of the chair with this button.
words.sentence_zh: 你可以用这个按钮调整椅子的高度。
words.roots: ad-（向）+ just（靠近，拉丁语 iuxta）→ 靠拢、对齐 → 调整

words.sentence: We had to alter our plans because of the heavy rain.
words.sentence_zh: 因为大雨，我们不得不改变计划。
words.roots: alter（另一个）→ 变成另一个样子 → 改变

words.sentence: Our teacher helped us analyze the poem line by line.
words.sentence_zh: 老师帮我们一行一行地分析这首诗。
words.roots: ana-（完全）+ lyze（松开，希腊语 lyein）→ 完全拆开 → 分析
family: paralyze 使瘫痪（松开到没力气）

words.sentence: The company holds an annual meeting every December.
words.sentence_zh: 公司每年十二月都会开年度会议。
words.roots: ann（年）+ -ual（…的）→ 每年的
words.hook: anniversary 周年纪念日：同一个 ann「年」

words.sentence: She sets aside some money every month for travel.
words.sentence_zh: 她每个月都留出一些钱用来旅行。
words.roots: a-（在）+ side（边）→ 在旁边 → 放到一边、留出
words.hook: side 边：a + side

words.sentence: The hotel received a complaint about the noise from the bar.
words.sentence_zh: 酒店收到了关于酒吧噪音的投诉。
words.roots: com-（加强）+ plaint（哀叹，拉丁语 plangere「捶胸痛哭」）→ 不停哀叹 → 抱怨、投诉（和 plain 平坦的无关）
words.hook: complain 抱怨：动词形式

words.sentence: It is hard to concentrate when my phone keeps ringing.
words.sentence_zh: 手机一直响的时候，很难集中注意力。
words.roots: con-（一起）+ centr（中心）+ -ate → 聚到中心 → 集中
words.hook: center 中心：同一个 centr

words.sentence: If you don't sleep enough, you will feel the consequences the next day.
words.sentence_zh: 如果你睡眠不足，第二天就会感受到后果。
words.roots: con-（一起）+ sequ（跟随）+ -ence → 跟着来的东西 → 后果
words.hook: second 第二：拉丁语 secundus「跟在后面」，同一个 sequ

words.sentence: Our electricity consumption is much higher in summer.
words.sentence_zh: 我们夏天的用电量高很多。
words.roots: con-（全部）+ sump（拿）+ -tion → 全部拿走用掉 → 消耗
words.hook: consume 消费：动词形式

words.sentence: She learned to cope with stress by going for long walks.
words.sentence_zh: 她学会了通过长时间散步来应对压力。

words.sentence: Rice is the main crop in this part of the country.
words.sentence_zh: 水稻是这个地区的主要农作物。

words.sentence: My grandfather cultivates vegetables in a small garden behind his house.
words.sentence_zh: 我爷爷在屋后的小菜园里种蔬菜。
words.roots: cult（耕种）+ -iv + -ate → 耕种 → 培育
words.hook: culture 文化：原意也是「耕种」，培养人的心灵

words.sentence: Good communication skills are highly desirable in this job.
words.sentence_zh: 这份工作非常需要良好的沟通能力。
words.roots: desire（渴望）+ -able（值得…的）→ 值得想要的 → 可取的
words.hook: desire 渴望：去掉 -able

words.sentence: He has a strong desire to travel around the world.
words.sentence_zh: 他非常渴望环游世界。

words.sentence: The city wants to reduce car emissions by thirty percent.
words.sentence_zh: 这座城市想把汽车排放减少百分之三十。
words.roots: e-（出）+ miss（送）+ -ion → 送出去的东西 → 排放物
words.hook: mission 任务 / missile 导弹：同一个 miss「送」

words.sentence: The factory employs more than two hundred local workers.
words.sentence_zh: 这家工厂雇用了两百多名当地工人。
words.roots: em-（进入）+ ploy（= plic，折叠；卷）→ 把人卷进来做事 → 雇用；使用
words.hook: imply 暗示：和 employ 来自同一个拉丁词 implicare

words.sentence: Every new employee gets a laptop on the first day.
words.sentence_zh: 每位新员工第一天都会拿到一台笔记本电脑。
words.roots: employ（雇用）+ -ee（被…的人）→ 被雇用的人
words.hook: employ 雇用

words.sentence: Every worker is entitled to twenty days of paid holiday a year.
words.sentence_zh: 每个员工每年都有权享受二十天带薪假期。
words.roots: en-（使）+ title（名称；名分）+ -d → 给了名称 / 名分 → 题为…的；有资格的
words.hook: title 标题

words.sentence: We estimate that the trip will take about three hours.
words.sentence_zh: 我们估计这次旅程大约需要三个小时。
words.roots: estim（估价，拉丁语 aestimare）+ -ate → 估价 → 估计

words.sentence: After many failed attempts, he eventually passed his driving test.
words.sentence_zh: 失败了很多次之后，他最终通过了驾照考试。
words.roots: e-（出）+ vent（来）+ -ual + -ly → 最后出来的结果 → 最终
words.hook: event 事件：同一个 vent「来」，发生出来的事

words.sentence: There is no evidence that this medicine really works.
words.sentence_zh: 没有证据表明这种药真的有效。
words.roots: e-（出）+ vid（看）+ -ence → 看得出来的东西 → 证据
words.hook: video 视频：同一个 vid「看」

words.sentence: The movie was good, but it didn't meet my expectations.
words.sentence_zh: 这部电影不错，但没有达到我的期望。
words.roots: ex-（出）+ (s)pect（看）+ -ation → 向外看着等 → 期望
words.hook: expect 期待：动词形式

words.sentence: Some plants can survive extreme heat in the desert.
words.sentence_zh: 有些植物能在沙漠的极端高温中存活。
words.roots: extr（= ex，外面）+ -eme（最）→ 最外面的 → 极端的
words.hook: exit 出口：同一个 ex「出、外」

words.sentence: It isn't fair that I always have to wash the dishes.
words.sentence_zh: 总是我洗碗，这不公平。

words.sentence: Good teachers foster a love of reading in their students.
words.sentence_zh: 好老师会培养学生对阅读的热爱。
words.hook: food 食物：真同源，foster 原意是「喂养」→ 培养

words.sentence: Too much sugar can harm your teeth.
words.sentence_zh: 吃太多糖会损害你的牙齿。

words.sentence: These results imply that the new method works better.
words.sentence_zh: 这些结果意味着新方法效果更好。
words.roots: im-（进入）+ ply（= plic，折叠）→ 把意思折在里面 → 暗示
words.hook: complicated 复杂的：com（一起）+ plic（折）→ 折在一起

words.sentence: The small shop made a good profit during the holidays.
words.sentence_zh: 这家小店在假期赚了不少钱。
words.roots: pro-（向前）+ fit（= fic，做）→ 做出进展 → 好处；利润
words.hook: fact 事实：fac ↔ fit，同一个「做」
family: benefit 好处（bene 好 + fit 做）

words.sentence: The test results revealed a problem with the engine.
words.sentence_zh: 测试结果揭示了发动机的一个问题。
words.roots: re-（反，去掉）+ veal（面纱）→ 揭开面纱 → 揭示
words.hook: veil 面纱：同一个词根
